# FG-INT-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`integrations`](../../ops/runbooks/integrations.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `binding_second_kanflow_project_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このプロジェクトは、すでに別の連携先のプロジェクトに結びついています。先に今の結びつけを解除してください。
- en: This project is already bound to another project of an integration. Unbind it first.
- id: Proyek ini sudah terikat ke proyek lain dari sebuah integrasi. Lepaskan ikatannya terlebih dahulu.

## 原因 (cause)

A bind named a forge project that already has a binding (`forge.integration_bindings` has at most one row per project, index `integration_bindings_one_per_project`): to another integration, or to the same integration with another `external_project_id` (02 §2: one forge project is never bound to two kanflow projects, or `PBI-123` would be ambiguous). The binding is not moved silently. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (`bound_to_other_integration` or `bound_to_other_external_project`), `project_id`, `integration_id` (the requested one) and `bound_integration_id`, with `action=IntegrationBindingManage`; never the external project ids. `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/integration-bindings` shows the current binding.

## 対処 (fix)

If the project really moves to another kanflow project, a Maintainer unbinds it first (`DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}/integration-bindings/{bound_integration_id}`), then binds it again (runbook integrations). Binding the same project to the same external project again is not an error (it answers `unchanged`).
